ar.title: طاجن اللحم باليخني

steps.n1: يُضاف للبصل قليل من الملح ويُقلب على نار متوسطة حتى يمتص ماءه ويحمر لونه، فيُضاف إليه قليل جداً من الماء ويُقلب حتى يمتصه، وهكذا حتى يحمر اللون تماماً، ثم يُضاف السمن ويُقلب 5 دقائق.
steps.n2: تُضاف الطماطم المصفاة واللحم ويُقلب الجميع على نار هادئة 10 دقائق، ثم يُصب عليه قليل من الماء ويغلي 5 دقائق.
steps.n3: يوضع البصل واللحم في طاجن ويُغطى ويدخل الفرن.
steps.n4: يُرفع الغطاء قبل تمام النضج ليحمر الوجه.
steps.n5: تُوضع حول الطاجن ورقة مشرشرة الحافة تُثبت بدبوس، ويُقدم على صحن.

en.title: Meat Tagine with Onion Stew

steps.n1: Add a little salt to the onions and stir over medium heat until they absorb their liquid and turn golden; add a very little water and stir until it is absorbed, and repeat until they are fully browned, then add the ghee and stir for 5 minutes.
steps.n2: Add the strained tomato and the meat and stir everything over low heat for 10 minutes, then pour in a little water and boil for 5 minutes.
steps.n3: Put the onions and meat into a tagine dish, cover and bake in the oven.
steps.n4: Remove the lid shortly before it is done so the top can brown.
steps.n5: Wrap a paper frill around the tagine, fix it with a pin and serve on a plate.

legacySteps: Add a little salt to the onions and stir over medium heat until they absorb their liquid and turn golden; add a very little water and stir until it is absorbed, and repeat until they are fully browned, then add the ghee and stir for 5 minutes.

Put the onions and meat into a tagine dish, cover and bake in the oven.
Remove the lid shortly before it is done so the top can brown.
Wrap a paper frill around the tagine, fix it with a pin and serve on a plate.
